risks.title: Commodity Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: Valero is heavily exposed to volatility in crude oil, refined product prices, and feedstock costs. This directly impacts refining and renewable diesel segment margins, which are core to the business model. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Fluctuations in commodity prices for crude oil, gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and feedstocks significantly impact profitability. Company uses derivative instruments for hedging.
risks.description: Fluctuations in commodity prices for crude oil, gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and feedstocks significantly impact profitability. Company uses derivative instruments for hedging. Cet enjeu reste à surveiller dans la trajectoire du groupe.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: Valero faces increasing regulatory requirements for renewable fuel standards (RFS), low-carbon fuel programs, environmental standards, and GHG emissions regulations across multiple jurisdictions. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Compliance costs for renewable fuel programs and environmental regulations, including RIN prices and low-carbon fuel mandates, can impact operational efficiency and capital allocation.
risks.description: Compliance costs for renewable fuel programs and environmental regulations, including RIN prices and low-carbon fuel mandates, can impact operational efficiency and capital allocation. Cet enjeu reste à surveiller dans la trajectoire du groupe.

risks.title: Interest Rate and Financing Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations affect the cost of borrowing for capital investments and operations, but Valero generates substantial cash flow that mitigates this risk. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Rising interest rates increase borrowing costs for capital expenditures and refinancing of existing debt obligations.
risks.description: Rising interest rates increase borrowing costs for capital expenditures and refinancing of existing debt obligations. Une dégradation des marchés renchérirait le coût de financement.

risks.title: Asset Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: Recent asset impairment charges at Benicia and Wilmington refineries highlight the risk of stranded assets if market fundamentals deteriorate or transition risks accelerate. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Changes in market conditions, demand for refined products, or regulatory shifts could trigger further impairment charges on refining assets and require asset retirement obligations.
risks.description: Changes in market conditions, demand for refined products, or regulatory shifts could trigger further impairment charges on refining assets and require asset retirement obligations. Cet enjeu reste à surveiller dans la trajectoire du groupe.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Supply Chain Risk
risks.score_rationale: Global conflicts affect crude oil supply and pricing. Trade restrictions and sanctions can impact feedstock availability and market access. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Geopolitical conflicts, trade tensions, OPEC+ dynamics, and sanctions on crude oil producing nations affect crude availability, prices, and operational planning.
